label: LLM Params
description: Completion parameters for LLM nodes (system prompt, sampling, reasoning, max tokens), the same for any provider. LLM nodes that share settings share one LlmParams node.

inputs.name: systemPrompt
inputs.label: System Prompt
inputs.description: Seeds the conversation as its first (role system) message and rides the history from then on. A history already opening with a system message keeps its own, so to switch instructions mid-chain append a system message with Chat Message.

inputs.name: maxTokens
inputs.label: Max Tokens
inputs.description: The most tokens the reply may hold, thinking included on a reasoning model. Unset, nothing is sent and the provider's own default applies (Anthropic, which requires one, gets the model's largest output).

inputs.name: stop
inputs.label: Stop sequences
inputs.description: Generation stops when the model produces any of these strings.

inputs.name: reasoning
inputs.label: Enable Reasoning
inputs.description: Unset (default) sends nothing, so the provider's own default applies. Off asks the provider for no reasoning; on reasons at `reasoningEffort`. A model that cannot switch reasoning off fails with an error saying to set this on; a model with no reasoning fails with its provider's error: set this off.

inputs.name: reasoningEffort
inputs.label: Reasoning Effort
inputs.description: Only used when reasoning is on, sent as written. Unpicked means the provider's lowest effort.

inputs.name: forcePrepend
inputs.label: Force response prefix
inputs.description: Force the model's reply to start with this exact text (constrained generation).

outputs.name: params
outputs.description: Wire into one or more LLM nodes' params input.
